g.text: 1. Function: the main USB-C receptacle: USB 2.0 OTG0 and USB PD sink (5-12 V into the TPS2121)

g.desc: 1. Function: the main USB-C receptacle: USB 2.0 OTG0 and USB PD sink (5-12 V into the TPS2121)

g.text: or source (5 V from eFuse #C); FUSB302B with the mainline fusb302 + tcpm drivers.

g.desc: or source (5 V from eFuse #C); FUSB302B with the mainline fusb302 + tcpm drivers.

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Dead battery: TPD8S300A RPD_Gx tied to C_CCx so a source

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Dead battery: TPD8S300A RPD_Gx tied to C_CCx so a source

g.text: sees Rd with the protection unpowered (§9.2.2.2); its CC FETs pass once vcc3v3_pmu is up.

g.desc: sees Rd with the protection unpowered (§9.2.2.2); its CC FETs pass once vcc3v3_pmu is up.

g.text: 3. D±: TPD4E05U06 (0.5 pF) at the receptacle; the TPD8S300A D1-D4 clamps are grounded as

g.desc: 3. D±: TPD4E05U06 (0.5 pF) at the receptacle; the TPD8S300A D1-D4 clamps are grounded as

g.text: unused (§9.2.2.6). Common-mode choke footprint (HDG Figure 2-44): not fitted, open item.

g.desc: unused (§9.2.2.6). Common-mode choke footprint (HDG Figure 2-44): not fitted, open item.

g.text: 4. VBUSDET: HDG divider 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ (3.0 V at 5 V); the pin's rating at 9-12 V VBUS is

g.desc: 4. VBUSDET: HDG divider 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ (3.0 V at 5 V); the pin's rating at 9-12 V VBUS is

g.text: UNVERIFIED (BOM §7 item 41): bench item before a PD contract above 5 V is enabled.

g.desc: UNVERIFIED (BOM §7 item 41): bench item before a PD contract above 5 V is enabled.

g.text: 5. VCONN not sourced (no e-marked cable supply): VCONN pins open, UNVERIFIED termination.

g.desc: 5. VCONN not sourced (no e-marked cable supply): VCONN pins open, UNVERIFIED termination.

g.text: 6. SBU to test pads (debug UART option, feature blocks #9); the TPD8S300A FLT on a test pad.

g.desc: 6. SBU to test pads (debug UART option, feature blocks #9); the TPD8S300A FLT on a test pad.
